$comment: MCP tool definitions. 'output' names the response data shape: list:<Def> or one:<Def> from schemas.json.

tools.name: sports_list_leagues
tools.title: List leagues
tools.description: List the leagues this server covers, with the league ids other tools take.

tools.name: sports_list_teams
tools.title: Find teams
tools.description: Find teams by name, city, abbreviation or nickname (e.g. 'leafs', 'Green Bay'), or list a league's teams. Returns canonical team ids like nhl:tor.

league.description: League id (nfl, nhl, nba, mlb, ncaaf, ncaab, epl, laliga, bundesliga). Required unless search is given.

tools.name: sports_get_games
tools.title: Games and scores
tools.description: Schedule and scores for a league or team over a date range (defaults to today). Use for 'what games are on tonight', 'Saturday's results', 'Leafs games this week'. Live games are refreshed; times are UTC plus localStart in the requested timezone.

league.description: League id. Required unless team is given.

team.description: Team id (nhl:tor) or name ('Maple Leafs'). Combine with league to disambiguate.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, today, tomorrow or yesterday. Default today.

from.description: Range start YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive), instead of date

timezone.description: IANA timezone for dates and localStart, e.g. America/Toronto. Default America/New_York.

tools.name: sports_get_live_scores
tools.title: Live scores
tools.description: Games in progress right now with current score, period and clock. Omit league for all leagues. Scores are near-live (seconds behind the broadcast).

league.description: League id; omit for all leagues

team.description: Only this team's game: id or name

refresh.description: Bypass the normal freshness window (still rate-limited)

tools.name: sports_get_game
tools.title: One game
tools.description: Current state of one game by id (from a games, live or schedule result).

refresh.description: Bypass the normal freshness window (still rate-limited)

tools.name: sports_get_team_schedule
tools.title: Team schedule
tools.description: A team's recent and upcoming games: by default its last 3 results and next 5 games. Use for 'when do the Leafs play next' or 'how did the Packers do last week'.

team.description: Team id (nhl:tor) or name ('Maple Leafs', 'Green Bay Packers')

league.description: League id, to disambiguate a team name (e.g. 'kings' in nhl)

from.description: Range start YYYY-MM-DD, instead of last 3 / next 5

timezone.description: IANA timezone for dates and localStart
